entities.summary: Antonio Garrigues Díaz-Cañabate, 1st Marquess of Garrigues was a Spanish politician who served as the Spanish Ambassador to the United States between 1962 and 1964 and Minister of Justice of Spain between 1975 and 1976, during the Francoist dictatorship.

entities.summary: Antonio Garrigues Díaz-Cañabate, 1st Marquess of Garrigues was a Spanish politician who served as the Spanish Ambassador to the United States between 1962 and 1964 and Minister of Justice of Spain between 1975 and 1976, during the Francoist dictatorship.
